queries.text: "dissolução do eu" rendered "dissolution of the I" (Gurdjieff/Samael Aun Weor usage; cf. glossary "eus" → "I’s"). Alternative: "dissolution of the self". "battered man syndrome" is in English in the original.
Idiom "esmurrando facas" (from "dar murro em ponta de faca", lit. "punching the point of a knife": a futile, self-harming struggle) rendered "banging our heads against a wall".
